resharper_apply_auto_detected_rules #

Undocumented ReSharper property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified Tier C — accepted and deliberately ignored. Flat at both values on a fixture whose wrapping demonstrably moves (resharper_csharp_wrap_arguments_style is CONFORMANT with three distinct outputs on it). It asks the IDE to prefer rules auto-detected from the surrounding source over the configured ones, which is an editor behaviour; Tier C is confirmed and no fixture is owed.

resharper_continuous_line_indent #

The size of one continuation level. Inert: the oracle returns wrapped arguments, binary chains, ternaries and call chains unchanged at double. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable / inert. Flat at single and double on two fixtures that demonstrably carry continuation indents — a chopped argument list and a chopped binary chain in one, a wrapped parenthesized expression at max_line_length = 60 in the other.

resharper_use_indent_from_vs #

Undocumented ReSharper property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified Tier C — accepted and deliberately ignored. ⚠ Observable, and decisively an editor setting: under indent_style = tab, true makes the oracle abandon the .editorconfig's tabs and emit Visual Studio's own four spaces, while false honours the file. Skala has no IDE settings to defer to, so an oracle glob would report INERT for a difference nobody intends to close. Tier C confirmed.

resharper_use_indents_from_main_language_in_file #

Undocumented ReSharper property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable by construction. Flat at both values on three fixtures, one of them tab-indented under indent_style = tab, where resharper_csharp_max_line_length and resharper_csharp_indent_size demonstrably move the layout.
